'''Ferros VI''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[Ferros system/Legends|Ferros system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camp<ref name="CSWE" /> on<ref name="DS2" /> the planet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Remember, though, that the Death Star has some of the best trained Imperial soldiers and technicians in the galaxy. If you use its detention block as a model for the prison camp on Ferros VI, you'll have to adjust game stats to match your view of that particular planet.|''Death Star Technical Companion''|<ref name="DS1">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref>}}
Ferros VI was introduced in [[Bill Slavicsek]]'s [[1991]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''. In the book, it is mentioned in a hypothetical gameplay discussion in which the gamemaster player models a prison camp on Ferros VI on a [[Detention area|detention block]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Death Star/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="DS1" /> The [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' subsequently [[canon]]ized the planet in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity,<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ferros [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Ferros VI, in grid square N-7.<ref name="TEA" />
